items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: He had another guy named Charlie Dixon used to write for him. Charlie wrote the hard stuff.

ctx.x: He called a different writer he used to have, a guy named Alexander. (Inaudible) in the band, Ron Alexander. (Inaudible) MariO, you may not get a chance. I say (inaudible) something and let me try. I'll get it in the rehearsal. Let me try. If the man like, you start, maybe he go give you work. So he made an arrangement for the band. He made "Liza." We recorded it. Chick went crazy.
He started getting work -- some -- order some for me, for me to play. He had another guy named Charlie Dixon used to write for him. Charlie wrote the hard stuff.
You were playing solo trumpet as well, were you?
